item.title: Asian traders cheer US rate cut but gains tempered by outlook
item.description: Most Asian markets rose Thursday as traders welcomed the Federal Reserve's third straight interest rate cut, though the euphoria was tempered by an indication officials could hold off another reduction any time soon. However, traders have lowered their expectations for a string of further cuts in 2026 after the bank's statement used language used in late-2024 to signal a pause in more rate cuts.
